_about: Title rules for the Exhibit Adoption view's CIP Sectors filter and row sections. Ordered: the first rule whose pattern matches the unified credential title (case-insensitive) names the two-digit CIP family. excel_to_dashboard.py applies them FIRST for Standardized Assessment cards (AP, CLEP, IB, DSST: the exam's subject is in its title, and MAP's TOP id for an exam is a coarse general-education code that filed AP Chemistry under Liberal Arts), and as the FALLBACK for every other card whose TOP route finds nothing. A title no rule matches keeps its TOP sector, or reads 'No CIP assigned yet'. A grouping and filter aid only (Rule 7): it decides nothing about identity.
_ruling: Sam, 2026-09-25: 'CIP sector is best ... We only need the CIP sector on this tab for filter and quick categorization. I would be just as happy if you used your own analysis from your knowledge to create the sectors yourself. I don't want to get sucked into the top/CIP black hole, which is it's own project.'
_authored: SkyZ S288, 2026-09-25, from the 669 titles that were exams or had no sector that day; every match was read by sector before shipping. Add a rule or a title here, never in code.
